user.title: Blind Control
user.description: Create a controller for one or more covers that move together (e.g. all shades on one window wall).

positions.name: Positions
positions.description: Positions use Home Assistant's convention: 0% is closed, 100% is open.

data_description.default_position: Used when no rule, oversteer or sun control applies.
data_description.min_position: Hard lower limit for every automatic position.
data_description.max_position: Hard upper limit for every automatic position.
data_description.min_delta: Smaller changes are not sent to the covers (except moving fully open/closed). Prevents constant small movements with sun tracking.

sun.name: Sun control
sun.description: Shade the window while the sun shines into it.

data_description.sun_mode: Restrict: move to a fixed shade position while the sun is in the window. Maximize: keep the shade as open as possible while stopping direct sun beyond the floor distance.
data_description.azimuth: Compass direction the window faces (north 0°, east 90°, south 180°, west 270°).
data_description.azimuth_left: How far left of the window direction the sun can shine in (looking out).
data_description.azimuth_right: How far right of the window direction the sun can shine in (looking out).
data_description.min_elevation: Below this the sun is blocked, e.g. by buildings or trees.
data_description.max_elevation: Above this the sun is blocked, e.g. by an overhang.

window.name: Window geometry (maximize mode)
window.description: Heights are measured from the floor.

data.floor_length: Allowed sun distance on the floor

data_description.floor_length: How far direct sunlight may reach into the room, measured from the window.

override.name: Overrides
override.description: Manual changes pause automatic control for a while.

data_description.detect_manual: Treat cover movements not made by Blind Control (wall switch, remote, app, dashboard) as a manual override.
data_description.override_duration: How long manual overrides (and actions without a duration) last. 0 keeps them until cleared or reset by a rule.
data_description.manual_priority: Rules with a higher priority than this win over manual overrides.
data_description.tolerance: Reported positions this close to the commanded position are not treated as manual changes.
data_description.update_interval: Maximum time between evaluations. Scheduled changes are always evaluated on time.

error.min_above_max: The minimum position must not be above the maximum position.
error.min_elevation_above_max: The minimum elevation must be below the maximum elevation.
error.window_bottom_above_top: The window bottom must be below the window top.

user.title: Rule
user.description: A rule applies during its time window, on the selected weekdays, while its conditions are met. Rules are checked in order; the first active Position rule wins.

data.name: Name
data.reset_override: Clear overrides when the rule starts

data_description.action: Position sets an absolute position. Minimum/Maximum limit sun control, oversteer and default positions.
data_description.weekdays: Leave empty for every day. For windows crossing midnight, the day the window starts counts.
data_description.conditions: Optional Home Assistant conditions (all must be met).
data_description.priority: A Position rule with a priority higher than an override's priority wins over the override.
data_description.reset_override: When the rule becomes active, any override is cleared (e.g. close at sunset even if someone opened the shade in the afternoon).

data_description.kind: Fixed time or a sun event. Leave at None for no boundary (midnight).
data_description.time: Only used for the Fixed time type.
data_description.offset: Minutes added to the time (negative for earlier).

user.title: Oversteer
user.description: Oversteer replaces sun control while its conditions are met, e.g. open when it is cloudy or close fully when it is hot.

data.name: Name
data.only_when_sun_in_window: Only while the sun is in the window

data_description.conditions: Home Assistant conditions (all must be met), e.g. cloud coverage above 80%.
data_description.only_when_sun_in_window: If off, the oversteer also applies while the sun is not in the window (whenever no Position rule is active).
data_description.order: Lower numbers are checked first; the first match wins.

duration.description: How long the override lasts. Defaults to the configured override duration; 0 lasts until cleared.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Position rules with a higher priority win over this override. Defaults to the manual override priority.
